CreatePurchaseOrder.description_en: Creates a purchase order and returns the purchase order ID. The specific result of order creation is communicated through messages. After the order is created, you can query the order details associated with the purchase order using the order API
CreatePurchaseOrder.description_zh: 创建采购单，返回采购单号，具体订单创建结果由消息侧通知。订单创建完成之后，客户可以通过订单接口查询采购单下附属的订单信息

GetOrder.description_en: Queries the details of an order

GetRefundOrder.description_en: Retrieve details of an after-sales order

GetSelectionProduct.description_en: Query the details of a product in the selection pool

GetSelectionProductSaleInfo.description_en: Queries sales information for products in the selection pool
GetSelectionProductSaleInfo.description_zh: 查询选品池商品销售信息

ListLogisticsOrders.description_en: Query logistics information for an order

ListSelectionProductSaleInfos.description_en: Query product sales information for the selection pool in batches
ListSelectionProductSaleInfos.description_zh: 批量查询选品池商品销售信息

ListSelectionProducts.description_en: Retrieves a list of products from a product selection pool

ListSelectionSkuSaleInfos.description_en: Query SKU sales information for items in the selection pool in batch
ListSelectionSkuSaleInfos.description_zh: 批量查询选品池SKU销售信息

RenderPurchaseOrder.description_en: Renders a purchase order and returns both sellable and unsellable products. Customers can then select the sellable products to place their orders
RenderPurchaseOrder.description_zh: 采购单渲染，会返回可售商品和不可售商品，客户可以选择可售商品进行采购单下单

SearchProducts.description_en: The product search API is a paginated interface for searching products based on various criteria
SearchProducts.description_zh: 商品搜索接口，提供按不同条件搜索合适商品的分页接口

SelectionGroupAddProduct.description_en: The distributor takes delivery of goods

SelectionGroupRemoveProduct.description_en: Removes products from a distributor's stock

SplitPurchaseOrder.description_en: Splits a purchase order and renders the resulting parent-child order structure. This API returns a list of items based on the final parent-child order structure. Distributors can use this response to render the final parent-child order layout, which simplifies receiving the purchase order creation success message and backfilling parent-child order information later
SplitPurchaseOrder.description_zh: 采购单渲染拆单接口，可以依照最终主子单结构方式返回商品列表，分销商接入方可以渲染得到最终的主子单结构，方便后续接收创建采购单成功消息并回填主子单信息
